title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
summary: Mecka AI 宣布获红杉领投的 6000 万美元 B 轮，用人体传感器和手机采集日常动作数据，用于人形及其他机器人训练。
investorNote: 机器人数据采集正形成独立融资赛道，但数据规模之外还需检验动作质量和跨本体迁移。

evidence.quote:
Mecka AI, a startup that collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots, announced it has raised a
$60 million Series B
round led by Sequoia, with participation from Nvidia, Microsoft’s venture fund M12, and others.

Founded in 2024, the startup intends to do for robotics what Scale AI, Mercor, Surge, and other data-labeling companies have done for LLMs. Those companies supply the human-generated data these systems learn from. Mecka pays people to record themselves doing everyday tasks, like making coffee or fixing cars, while wearing body sensors and using smartphones.

displayTitle: Mecka AI 获 6000 万美元 B 轮，机器人训练数据平台继续获投
narrative: Mecka AI 宣布完成红杉领投的 6000 万美元 B 轮，NVIDIA 和微软风投 M12 等参与。公司让参与者佩戴传感器、使用手机记录咖啡制作、修车等动作，供机器人训练。融资表明具身智能的数据层有独立商业机会；真正的壁垒仍需通过数据标注质量、可复用性及对不同机器人任务的效果来验证。

eventRelation.reason: 这是 Mecka AI 新融资，历史候选无同次发生。
